rules.writeSets: Write sets are REISSUED by each lane's acceptance author against the tree at dispatch (after B-SHELL-P1 moved chrome into TRUNK/shell). A canvas lane never edits TRUNK/shell/**. A tldraw-side adapter that P1 leaves under APP/src/chrome/** has exactly ONE owning lane, named in its writeSet here; nobody else edits it.
rules.mechanismVsControl: Canvas lanes deliver the MECHANISM plus a named command (a function the chrome can call) and prove it with a test that calls the command. The user-facing CONTROL (pill row, menu row, inspector row) is delivered by the one chrome lane that owns that surface, which runs after the mechanism merged and must cite the file:line where the control calls the command. An item is DONE only when both halves merged.
rules.expectedRed: LEDGER.md carries EXPECTED_RED: the W0 failing set (10 studio tests) plus the FLAKY_FILES allowance (a failure in those files is re-run once alone and counts only if it fails again). A merge may not add a red outside EXPECTED_RED. G-FLAKE merging removes the flaky allowance; G-STALE removes corner.smoke + the burger order; L-FILES removes draft.smoke x7 + the menus View/Preferences/Export case. The dispatcher updates the list at each such merge.
rules.peerOwned: Never edit: APP/stable-preview.json, scripts/launch_systemsketch.py, scripts/tests/*launch*, assets/bbox-ui.desktop, APP/src/chrome/{sites,legacyApp,siteStatus}.ts, APP/devFileHost.ts, scripts/dock_icon.py, scripts/launch_bboxui.py — a peer session's switcher lane (EXT-SWITCHER) owns them.
rules.g5Preflight: G5 uses a BUILD-ONLY preflight: pnpm docs:build, npx shadcn@latest build, python3 docs/verify_registry_install.py --dir <scratch>. scripts/preflight.sh's origin/main ancestry check fails by design on an unpushed integration branch; never 'fix' it by pushing.
rules.coverage: Every item in a lane's items AND every id in its scheduled clusters (untriaged-clusters.md) gets exactly one LEDGER line: done (user action file:line or tested command), done-already, obsolete, or follow-up (outside this lane's write set; named for W5). The acceptance author writes a test or a line for each; never widens a write set to reach one.
rules.text: Every new text or number field writes on each keystroke (no local buffer committed on blur — the P-030 rule) and joins the P-030 block in APP/src/textEditing.smoke.test.tsx; every new gesture is ONE undo step (APP/src/document/gestureHistory.ts). Donors that buffer until blur (packages/panel NumberInput, packages/inspector ScrubNumber) are adapted, not copied.
rules.guards: W1 brings two ratchet tests that fail in BOTH directions: APP/src/settingsAreWired.test.ts (QUARANTINE of dead settings) and APP/src/chromeActionsAreWired.test.ts (quarantined chrome callbacks). A lane that makes a quarantined entry live removes it from the quarantine in the same commit; B-SHELL-P1 extends chromeActionsAreWired's scan to TRUNK/shell.
rules.longRuns: Suites longer than the 10-minute Bash cap: start them with `nohup ... > <log> 2>&1 & echo $! > <pid>` and wait with repeated `timeout 570 tail --pid=$(cat <pid>) -f /dev/null`; never a foreground sleep; never kill another process's run on port 63315 — wait for it.
rules.verify: The integration check after every merge: `pnpm -r typecheck`; `pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 test` (every package's tests, one at a time because of the shared browser port); `python3 -m pytest -q scripts/tests` when scripts/ or a launcher changed. Compare the failing set to EXPECTED_RED.
